dsh-design-qa 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。给纯文本模型的设计稿保真判定：`deepseek_vision` 工具从任意 OpenAI 兼容视觉路由借来一只眼，让模型判断实现与设计稿是否一致——并附上支撑该判定的基准（4 组夹具、23 处注入缺陷、逐格原始输出）与其依赖的提问纪律。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-022dfc9377f3682810ce.html
posts.en:
dsh-design-qa is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Design-fidelity QA for text-only models: a `deepseek_vision` tool borrows an eye from any OpenAI-compatible vision route, so the model can judge whether an implementation matches its mock — shipped with the benchmark behind that judgement (four fixtures, 23 injected defects, raw transcripts) and the questioning discipline it depends on.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-022dfc9377f3682810ce.html
